assumptions: The s5-frozen headers and build/documentation files are delivered by the s5 generation stage and are not task-owned delivery slots.
Task work packages own only the s6_owned source slots declared in the delivery constraints.
Only the server role is targeted; client-only behaviors are reflected as server-side validation and response obligations.
Session state is server-resident and includes the subscriptions required by REQ-SESSION-002.
The network module owns connection I/O only; the application entry point composes codec, session, and network behavior.

contracts.purpose: Expose the generated MQTT 3.1.1 protocol type declarations.
Expose the generated per-message encode and decode declarations.
Expose the session and topic-matching boundary to the server application.
Expose the connection I/O and output-batch boundary to the server application.

decisions.statement: The generated protocol type and codec declarations are s5-ready contracts owned and provided by the s5 generation stage, not by task modules.
Session state, subscriptions, and topic matching are owned by the session module and are not duplicated in the network or codec modules.
The network module owns connection I/O and keep-alive timing; protocol orchestration is performed by the application entry point.
Protocol and transient errors close only the connection that produced the offending control packet.
The application entry point composes the codec, session, and network contracts without reimplementing any of their behavior.

modules.name: MQTT Codec
non_goals: Do not modify the frozen generated headers.
modules.purpose: Implement the per-message wire encode and decode functions declared by the generated codec contract.
responsibilities: Implement per-message encode and decode functions for all ten target message types.
Enforce fixed-header flags, remaining length, big-endian integers, and MQTT UTF-8 string wire rules during decode.
Reject malformed client control packets at the wire layer.

modules.name: MQTT Session
non_goals: Do not perform wire encoding or decoding.
modules.purpose: Own server-resident session state, subscriptions, and topic matching.
responsibilities: Maintain per-client session state including subscriptions.
Match topic filters against topic names for application-message routing.
Remove only the exact subscription requested by a matching UNSUBSCRIBE.

modules.name: MQTT Network
non_goals: Do not parse MQTT control packets.
modules.purpose: Own connection I/O and keep-alive timing using the server ABI.
responsibilities: Accept and manage client network connections.
Emit output batches using the server ABI.

modules.name: MQTT Server Application
non_goals: Do not reimplement codec, session, or network functionality.
modules.purpose: Compose codec, session, and network modules into the server application entry point.
responsibilities: Wire inbound connection bytes to codec decoding and outbound packets to the network output batch.
Apply connection-scoped protocol and transient error handling.
Drive the server event loop from the network interface.

acceptance.outcome: All ten codec source files compile and the MQTT 3.1.1 reference codec byte-vector tests pass.

work_packages.goal: Implement encode and decode functions for all ten MQTT message types with wire validation.
work_packages.title: Per-message codec implementation

acceptance.outcome: The session module carries subscriptions across the session lifetime and a clean-session reconnect discards stored subscriptions.

work_packages.goal: Implement session state, clean-session lifecycle, subscriptions, and topic matching for the server.
work_packages.title: Session state and topic matching

acceptance.outcome: The network module accepts concurrent connections, emits output batches, and closes idle connections after the keep-alive timeout.

work_packages.goal: Implement connection I/O, output batches, and keep-alive timeouts using the server ABI.
work_packages.title: Network I/O and keep-alive handling

acceptance.outcome: The server application passes the L2 broker behavioral tests and closes only the source connection on protocol violations.

work_packages.goal: Compose codec, session, and network contracts into the mqtt_server_main application.
work_packages.title: Server application entry point
